selection: Minimum validation-unit MAE; normalization and constant baseline fitted on training units only
scope: Injected wear level reaches 9.0; conveyor is physically stopped. This is a functional-failure proxy, not a damaged-bearing mechanics model.
time_policy: Accelerated virtual operating seconds; each one-second signal window is synthesized from a newer physical joint observation. Virtual age is distinct from Gazebo sim_time and UTC.
